mbs.text: Sarja is a Neurok woman who is the only rival of Trennet in the competition for Research Spire Eleven, and she mocks him when they meet. Trennet notices she is carrying a clone shell of her own and guesses she plans to drop it near the Spire, wait until the Phyrexians mangle its humanoid form, and unleash a hellkite on them.

Trennet resolves to hide inside his own clone shell and dominate Sarja's beast once it appears, but a Phyrexianized seastrider knocks Sarja's shell off the platform, and the drake-lord knocks Trennet's shell onto the same platform. When Trennet attacks Sarja's clone shell to force it to transform, it only reforms as a humanoid, because it has been imprinted with another clone shell.

Each time the Phyrexians destroy Sarja's shell another humanoid shell emerges, and Trennet finds only more clone shells beneath. Sarja finally emerges from her last clone shell and kills the drake-lord with a dagger, then demands the Spire as the price for freeing Trennet, and he concedes.
Trennet is healed by Lumengrid shapers and the Spire is rebuilt, and Sarja holds it with a patrol of clone shells.
